arxiv-2504-04975.title: Geometric quantization of generalized Hirzebruch fibrations
arxiv-2504-04975.creator: Andrea Piccirilli
arxiv-2504-04975.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Andrea Piccirilli. Hirzebruch surfaces, defined as the projectivization of line bundles over ℂ ​ ℙ 1 \mathbb{C}\mathbb{P}^{1} , support a toric action and thus represent an infinite class of symplectic toric manifolds of complex dimension 2. In this paper, an infinite class of toric manifolds given as projective bundles over ℂ ​ ℙ d \mathbb{C}\mathbb{P}^{d} will be constructed for every complex dimension d d and it will be shown that each manifold supports a symplectic structure.

pmc-11661864.title: Alternative isoforms and phase separation of Ref1 repress morphogenesis in Cryptococcus
pmc-11661864.creator: Nathan K. Glueck, Xiaofeng Xie, Xiaorong Lin
pmc-11661864.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SUMMARYCryptococcus neoformans, the causative agent of cryptococcosis and a representative of the Basidiomycota phylum of Fungi, is a valuable model for our understanding of eukaryotic/fungal biology. Negative feedback is a well-documented mechanism across Eukarya to regulate developmental transitions. Here, we describe a repressor of the yeast-to-hypha transition, Ref1, which completes a negative feedback loop driven by the master regulator of hyphal morphogenesis, Znf2, during sexual development. Alternative transcription of Ref1, driven by Znf2, produces a functionally distinct Ref1 isoform.

pmc-12596639.title: The application of chimeric free anterolateral thigh flap and muscle flap for heel ulcer reconstruction: A case series and technical refinements
pmc-12596639.creator: Rui Yang, Wenhu Jin, Ziyang Zhang, Jianping Qi, Zairong Wei
pmc-12596639.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe free anterolateral thigh flap has become a preferred option for skin defect reconstruction, particularly for heel ulcers. Due to the heel's weight-bearing role and potential bone destruction from ulcers, an anatomical-functional repair is essential for functionality restoration. This study reports long-term outcomes of a chimeric ALT fasciocutaneous flap combined with vastus lateralis muscle for calcaneal ulcer reconstruction, showing restored heel weight-bearing capacity.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed nine consecutive cases of heel ulcers from June 2020 to June 2022.
